newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-Korea up again, India edges firmer.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-Korea up again, India edges firmer.

text.p: Korean global depositary receipts extended gains on Tuesday amid tight supply and following mild gains in Seoul stocks earlier, traders said.
But they said the market may struggle to extend gains in coming days following a recent strong run.
"They were up on a short squeeze but they are pretty near the top at these levels," said a trader.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index added 1.81 points to 77.04 points, a premium of 46.68 percent over the local market.
The Seoul composite index rose 7.67 points to end the day at 766.06.
Indian GDRs were higher after gains in Bombay, but traders said volumes were light and expected GDRs to drift around current levels without a strong run from local stocks.
"Volumes have been a bit lighter and the market is going to have to wait for local stocks to catch up," a dealer said.
The James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 0.72 points up at 83.27, with the premium over the local market at 27.48 percent from 25.33 percent.
Bombay's benchmark index closed up 30.67 points to 3,838.85.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index rose 0.08 points, or 0.07 percent, to 119.52, representing a discount to the local market of 2.17 percent.
